name: send-to-memos
title: Send to Memos
description: Capture thoughts, tags, and links in Memos, the open-source, self-hosted note-taking app.
author: jason-a9

commands.name: send-to-memos
commands.title: Send to Memos
commands.description: Write a memo with tags and an optional link, then send it to Memos.

commands.name: open-memos
commands.title: Open Memos
commands.description: Open your Memos website in the default browser.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Memos URL
preferences.description: Your Memos website URL, such as https://memos.example.com. Deployments under a subpath are supported.

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Create an access token in your Memos settings. Paste the token with or without the Bearer prefix.

preferences.name: defaultTags
preferences.title: Default Tags
preferences.description: Tags to append to new memos, separated by spaces or commas. Leave empty for no default tags.

preferences.name: defaultVisibility
preferences.title: Default Visibility
preferences.description: Who can read new memos. Private is the default.

preferences.name: openAfterSend
preferences.title: Open After Sending
preferences.label: Open the memo in a browser after sending
preferences.description: Open each memo in your browser after saving. You can also use Send and Open for individual memos.

preferences.name: apiVersion
preferences.title: API Version
preferences.description: Usually detected automatically with read-only requests. Choose an endpoint manually if needed.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.lint:code: eslint src tests && prettier --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json README.md CHANGELOG.md
